cs.t: At home - JVC HA-SZ2000 & AKG K701 (10 yrs old, still going strong, recently replaced the pads), Both driven through a MHDT DAC and a Magni 2 amp. I also have a tube amp that I rarely use these days. (Little Dot MK3, need to replace the tubes) I avoid in-ear headphones as I don't like the compromised sound quality.
